initializers_rationale: Chosen prospectively from prior known DEV successes solely to diagnose revisions. Not a general deployment selector or a new end-to-end method claim. Same initializer/base for all revision arms.
sequence: One typed COLD call, then SINGLE INITIAL and three revision branches, then AMENDMENT INITIAL and three branches. All three branches fork the exact same actual committed model-owned snapshot. No reference base, previous-run state or success-conditioned retries. Missing or wrong initial bases remain in every denominator.
requests: Unchanged known development COLD, SINGLE and AMENDMENT requests, including previous compact-contract SINGLE patch. No new wording or independent test requests.
fairness: Each branch is charged the common initial-call cost plus its own revision cost. Physical execution is absent, and cold/load/startup costs are separately retained; branching is a controlled diagnostic, not free online retries. Named vs typed uses same output syntax but changes instructions and labeled state; witness additionally changes source/truth-table interface. Same full public information, no target training/examples.
acceptance: Candidate revision gate requires both 7B revisions correct, timely and complete from correct admitted self-generated bases, with all unrequested fields/epoch preserved. All 18 planned revision branches are retained. A passed revision gate alone NEVER admits new independent scenarios: previous full-initial-contract and deployment gates remain unresolved.
limitations: Citations certify source spans, numeric grounding and exact named-business presence, not semantic entailment or complete update coverage. Truth bits represent general Boolean functions over the two public events, not supervised control-action labels. Wrong supported Boolean functions and incorrect restore edits remain possible and scored as failures. No test-specific language classifier or gold allowed-field list reaches actors.
